about: UNIT 23 (fix/hma-floor-sqrt, engine e100): Hull's root window is floor(sqrt(n)), as TradingView computes ta.hma (FRED's Q-HMA capture, AMEX:SPY 1D: at n = 21 floor exact on 8,482/8,482 bars, round on none). Three Hull paths carry the rule: the engine's hullWindows (formula and runtime lanes), the Python twin _hma_col, and the native overlay's movingAverages hma. Each, put back to round, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: round-js: the engine's hullWindows rounds the root window again (both JS lanes)
round-py: the Python twin _hma_col rounds the root window again (floor(x + 0.5))
round-ma: the native moving-average overlay's hma rounds the root window again
